digest_kind_correction.cause: the local Docker daemon uses the containerd image store, which reports the index digest as the image ID and as the RepoDigest; the manifest's description was inferred from that reporting
digest_kind_correction.disposition: documentation-accuracy defect in the SS4 image-identity leg, recorded here for adjudication; NOT corrected in place, because the manifest is part of the RESOLVED binding and this record amends nothing
digest_kind_correction.documented_as: MR002_EvaluatorImageManifest.json field image_digest_kind reads 'content-addressed image config digest (docker image ID)'
digest_kind_correction.finding: the bound digest is an OCI image INDEX digest (application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json), not an image config digest
digest_kind_correction.identity_impact: NONE — the bound VALUE is correct and is registry-addressable exactly as bound; only its type DESCRIPTION was wrong
digest_kind_correction.resolver_impact: MATERIAL — a resolver written to the documented description would look for a config object under this digest and fail; it must resolve an image index

scope: custody and availability of the bound evaluator image ONLY; creates no authorization event, amends no sealed package, satisfies no prerequisite, and is NOT permission to begin P10

no numerical library/BLAS/LAPACK/CPU-dispatch/threading/floating-point/seed/determinism claim; P10 is not implied

verification_procedure.step_1: aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name mr002-evaluator-p5 --region us-east-1 --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:60b15568aa5960ee04cf10b8c9b006d2ee702aa815a17384beffc979ed4554c9 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' --output text
verification_procedure.step_2: sha256 of the returned manifest bytes MUST equal the bound digest
verification_procedure.step_4: on ANY mismatch or unavailability, STOP — do not rebuild, do not substitute a later image, do not fall back to the tag
